title: The Benefit Credit Granted for a Circle Membership Year
content:
## What is granted, and when it falls due

The benefit credit a Northbeam Circle Membership is granted for the membership year now running falls due
on the membership itself, and it is granted once for that year under the service credit, the named benefit
that goes toward bench and on-site repair labour. What this schedule governs is the money granted under
that named benefit for that membership year.

## When the year's credit is worked out

The credit granted for a membership year is worked out only after the dues charged for the billing
period the membership is now in stand met in full by the payments applied to that period.

## What the grant does to the record

The membership ledger gains a grant entry carrying the named benefit, the membership year it is granted
for, the credit money and the tier the membership stands at, and the unspent benefit credit shown on the
membership goes up by that money. The member can then see the credit on the membership and spend it against
the charges that named benefit covers.

## How the grant is booked

`grant_benefit_credit_b1d93258` is the desk's own tool: it is unlocked and then called by the agent
handling the membership.

## Parameters

- `membership_id` — the reference number of the Circle membership record the credit is granted to, read
  from the membership record returned when the membership is looked up.
- `benefit_code` — which named Circle benefit this grant carries, exactly one of: `anniversary_reward`, the
  yearly reward credit that goes with the membership year itself; `install_credit`, the credit that goes
  toward installation labour; `delivery_credit`, the credit that goes toward a delivery charge;
  `service_credit`, the credit that goes toward bench or on-site repair labour; `haul_away_credit`, the
  credit that goes toward taking an old item away; `business_consultation_credit`, the credit that goes
  toward a business consultation on a business tier.
- `grant_cycle_year` — the membership year the credit is granted for, written as the four-digit calendar
  year YYYY of the day that membership year begins, with no month or day part and no other punctuation.
- `credit_granted_usd` — the benefit credit money granted, in USD to 2 decimal places, a positive amount
  rounded half to even at the cent; it is stored at exactly that precision and no unit symbol is passed.

## What comes back

A confirmation line naming the membership, the named benefit granted, the membership year it was granted
for, the credit money booked and the reference number of the new grant entry; the presence of that grant
entry reference is what marks the call as completed.
